title: 2008 AMC 10A Problem 17
statement: An equilateral triangle has side length \(6.\) What is the area of the region containing all points that are outside the triangle and not more than \(3\) units from a point of the triangle?

solutions.text:
Along each of the three sides is a \(6 \times 3\) rectangle, contributing \(3 \cdot 6 \cdot 3 = 54.\)

At each vertex is a \(120^\circ\) sector of radius \(3;\) the three together form a full circle of area \(\pi \cdot 3^2 = 9\pi.\)

The total area is \(54 + 9\pi.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The region is three rectangles along the sides plus three sectors at the corners
The three corner sectors are each \(120^\circ,\) and together they make one full circle of radius \(3\)
